$description: HEADY(TM) design tokens v1.0.0 - W3C design-tokens format. Machine-readable single source for Claude design tools and v0.dev generation. Every value is derived from repo canon: packages/phi-math/src/index.mjs (phi constants, FIB), .agents/skills/heady-sacred-geometry-css-generator/SKILL.md (dark palette, type scale, motion), docs/adr/0026-mcp-console-ui-architecture.md (state colors, heartbeat), docs/compendium/09-infra-and-services.md SI6/SI7 (fonts, site accents, radius, 0.382s transition), apps/headyme-portal/src/components/heady-build-narrative.js (beat palette). (c) 2026 HeadySystems Inc. - Eric Haywood, Founder.

generatedFrom: packages/phi-math/src/index.mjs (PHI, PSI, PSI2, PHI_7, HEARTBEAT_MS, FIB, CSL_THRESHOLDS)
com.headysystems.provenance.regeneration: Values marked derived:true in $extensions have no canon source and were computed from the canonical dark palette + phi-math; see docs/design/README.md for the derivation rules.
com.headysystems.provenance.wcagValidated: Contrast ratios computed 2026-07-04 with the WCAG 2.1 relative-luminance formula; ratios quoted in $description fields.

phi.$description: Golden-ratio constants, verbatim from packages/phi-math/src/index.mjs (the phi source of truth, AGENTS.md #8).

major.$description: Layout major fraction (%) = PSI*100; canvas:drawer and grid splits per REBUILD_PLAN_V2 S8 (canvas:drawer ~ phi:1) and heady-living-dashboard SKILL (61.8fr/38.2fr grid).

coherenceBands.$description: CSL_THRESHOLDS from phi-math; heady-living-dashboard maps them to state color: >= HIGH healthy, >= LOW warning, < LOW danger.

dark.$description: Canonical dark premium palette - heady-sacred-geometry-css-generator SKILL.md :root block (authoritative).

muted.$description: De-emphasis only; below AA for body text - never for load-bearing copy

light.$description: DERIVED - no light palette exists in canon (canon gap, see README.md). Derivation rule: invert the dark neutrals about the same hue family (indigo-tinted neutrals, hue held), keep state hues, darken accents until text-grade >= 4.5:1 on bg.primary. All ratios computed, not asserted.

com.headysystems.provenance.rule: contrast-inversion of color.dark; hue family preserved

state.$description: Status honesty palette - ADR-0026 (teal healthy / violet degraded-or-projection / amber token-expired) + heady-build-narrative.js BEAT_STYLE (amber #ffb020 blocked, red #ff5470 fail). These are STATE SIGNALS, not wallpaper (REBUILD_PLAN_V2 S8).

degraded.$description: Violet - degraded, projection-only, plan/decision/gate beats. 4.61:1 on dark bg (AA).

onLight.$description: DERIVED text-grade variants for light theme (raw state hues fail on light: #00d4aa = 1.77:1, #7c5eff = 3.97:1). Same hue, darkened to >= 4.5:1 on light bg.primary.

siteAccents.$description: Per-site accent hues - docs/compendium/09-infra-and-services.md SI7 (the reconciled v2 list of 11 sites). NOTE canon drift: the sacred-geometry skill's older table gives headysystems.com #00d4aa; SI7 + ADR-0026 pair teal(headyme)+violet(headysystems) - SI7 wins (see README canon-gaps).

spacing.$description: Fibonacci spacing scale in px - values from phi-math FIB[4..12]. The sacred-geometry SKILL uses these exact px values (its fib() index comments are off by one; the phi-math array is authoritative: FIB[5]=5, FIB[6]=8, FIB[7]=13, FIB[8]=21, FIB[9]=34, FIB[10]=55, FIB[11]=89, FIB[12]=144).

display.$description: Admin console display face - compendium SI6 (MCP Console design system).

body.$description: User-facing site body face - compendium SI6 (V9 site system).

mono.$description: ALL machine values (ids, hashes, traceIds, endpoints, logs) - compendium SI6, both expressions.

scale.$description: phi type scale from heady-sacred-geometry-css-generator SKILL.md. xl/2xl/3xl/4xl are exact phi powers from phi-math: PHI=1.618033988749895, PHI2=2.618..., PHI3=4.236..., PHI4=6.854... (quoted at 3dp as canon CSS does).

radius.$description: Fibonacci radii. 13px is the canonical --heady-radius (compendium SI6, V9 system); glass panels use 13/21 (skill .glass/.glass-deep).

elevation.$description: Heady elevation = glassmorphism depth, not drop shadows (sacred-geometry skill .glass/.glass-deep). Depth is expressed by backdrop blur + saturation + border strength.

statusGlow.$description: Live-status dot glow - heady-build-narrative.js (.hbn-status::before box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--dot)). Color follows the state token.

motion.$description: phi-scaled motion. Durations from the sacred-geometry skill ramp (each step x phi); 382ms = PSI2 x 1000 is the V9 site transition (compendium SI6 'transition: 0.382s'); 29034ms = PHI_7 x 1000 is the golden heartbeat (phi-math HEARTBEAT_MS, ADR-0026 probe cadence).

heartbeat.$description: PHI_7 x 1000 - health probe / SSE reconnect cadence. Ambient pulse on healthy cells; suppressed under prefers-reduced-motion (REBUILD_PLAN_V2 S8).

backoff.$description: phiBackoffMs(n) = round(1000 x PHI^n) - reconnect/retry choreography (phi-math).

breakpoints.$description: DERIVED - no canonical breakpoints exist in the repo (canon gap, see README.md). Derivation: phi-native Fibonacci px straight from phi-math FIB[14..17], keeping the whole ramp on one lattice.

beatDomCap.$description: FIB[12] - max live-feed rows kept in DOM (heady-build-narrative MAX_BEATS).
